_comment: Asset catalog: one entry per foliage FAMILY (the type name without the trailing _01 / _Var02 variant numbers, see ue_foliage_census.py). Fill it BEFORE a model scatters a family, and audit the live level against it with: ue_foliage_census.py --project profile.json --heights live_heights.png --catalog this_file.json. Heights are metres above the sea surface (ground Z - sea_cm) / 100. near_water_m [min, max] is the distance to the nearest creek, lake or sea edge (null = no limit; [0, 0] means in the water itself); the census measures it on the heights grid (about 8 m per pixel on the test game) and needs --water-mask for creeks and lakes. Distance to water, not height above the sea, is the axis for water-bound families (wet_margin, aquatic, tree_riparian): creeks and lakes lie at any height, so those entries have no upper above_sea_m limit (null). Values below are the test game's (ZAS) and are starting points, not truths: look at the asset at eye level in sun and shade first, and set verified to the date you did.

categories.tree_upland: Canopy trees on dry ground; never in or at the water line; thin on steep ground.
categories.tree_riparian: Trees that want wet feet: creek banks and lake edges.
categories.shrub: Bushes and mid-storey plants on dry ground, clustered under or beside trees.
categories.groundcover: Low plants and ferns on shaded forest floor.
categories.grass: Grass tufts and patches; meadow and open ground; the main density carrier.
categories.flower: Flower patches in open ground, small clusters, never uniform.
categories.wet_margin: Marsh and emergent plants (sedges, broad-leaf marsh plants): creek banks, lake margins and the shallows; roots in wet ground, leaves above the water.
categories.aquatic: Floating or submerged plants: standing in water only, on a water body that is deep enough and calm enough.
categories.dune_coast: Beach and dune plants: sand layer, close above the sea, wind-exposed.
categories.dry_scrub: Drought plants: well-drained, high or sandy ground, away from water.
categories.rock: Boulders and pebbles: banks, slopes and creek beds; any ground but never floating.
categories.prop: Authored village props (houses, fences, barrels): only inside a placed village footprint, never scattered.

SM_Tree.notes: Wildwood trees; leaves read pale if the ambient light is high; keep 8 m back from the water line.

SM_Plant.notes: Wildwood broad-leaf rosettes: marsh plants. Place on creek and lake margins and in the shallows (within about two landscape pixels of water), not on dry upland. Census 2026-11-16: median 21 m above the sea and most instances far from any water, so most were misplaced; one alone on a dry slope was removed.

SM_MT_PM_V60_Cyperus_eragrostis.notes: Sedge: creek and lake margins, at any height above the sea. Census 2026-11-16: median 36 m above the sea and about 30 m from water, so it stood too far from the water.

SM_MT_PM_V60_Ammophila_arenaria.notes: Marram grass: sand layer close to the sea.
